summary:
# SPACE MEMORY – Guardians of the Space Legacy

SPACE MEMORY – Guardians of the Space Legacy is an interactive website and digital book that aims to recover and share the stories of the equipment and devices that remain on the Moon and Mars after NASA space missions.

Our proposal consists of creating a digital space where users can explore environments on both worlds, discover vehicles, scientific instruments, and other space equipment, learn about their functions, and discover the missions in which they participated.

The platform will combine 3D technology, photographs, scientific information, and educational challenges to transform learning into an interactive experience.

This project addresses the challenge by bringing visibility to lesser-known space objects and highlighting their importance in the history of space exploration. It is important because it promotes science education, sparks young people's curiosity, and encourages interest in technology, research, and responsible space exploration.
